user_trigger: Was the trial paper highest priority or just underway when premature demotions were challenged? Is this best token use?
review_mode: Fresh-context read-only medium subagent; existing top-four evidence only; no new experiment or network.
finding: Trial received the first focused remediation assessment, not a promotion to highest scientific value. Current evidence does not justify committing to further bulk label review ahead of a cheaper discriminating baseline test.

candidate_limits.atlas: Patient overlap and reference/annotation compatibility unresolved; limited normal panel and cancer-discovered transformed peaks constrain validation. No established independent adult-organ contrast.
candidate_limits.fusion: 31 designs with partial measured-parent outcomes; second-parent measurements remain unknown and independent comparable families missing. A retrospective score test would not establish transferable both-parent sparing.
candidate_limits.response: Extractor defects demonstrated; selected pilot does not yet establish a new synthesis method or independent validation.
candidate_limits.trial: Disease-name misses remain parent-sarcoma-findable. Review-burden/ranking advantage against competent ordinary/hierarchy retrieval is untested; bounded query-union frame cannot establish global recall.

next_allocation: One bounded frozen matched-information ordinary/hierarchy baseline versus molecular augmentation test, starting with label-independent output differences; no more bulk independent label reading yet.
scientific_safeguards: Freeze methods, review budgets, uncertainty treatment and interpretation before looking at performance.
If rankings differ, any evaluation on prior independently adjudicated pairs is descriptive with selection/ascertainment limits; unjudged pairs remain unknown.
No outcome-based label tuning or successful-method-based sample selection. Small selected-subset failure does not prove futility.
Do not promote trial above atlas solely because computation is cheap or labeling work is sunk. Reassess allocation from the actual discriminating result.
